entities.summary: Jordan Patrick Pacheco is an American former professional baseball infielder and catcher who is a hitting coach for the Colorado Rockies in Major League Baseball (MLB). He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Rockies, Arizona Diamondbacks and the Cincinnati Reds.
